svg.title: Polar-factor rotation caused by unequal clipping
svg.desc: Unit directions obtained by applying the orthogonal polar factors to e1, the first coordinate unit vector. Q(A)e1 makes an angle of minus 11.309932 degrees with e1. Q(B)e1 makes an angle of minus 22.5 degrees, a clockwise change of 11.190068 degrees. Multiplying A by any positive scalar leaves its polar factor Q(A) unchanged. These arrows depict columns of the polar factors, not columns of the mean matrices. This is a deterministic teaching example, not a training result.
